structure Prereset (B : Directed G I Z K P) (q : ResetPrices) (s : Set ℝ) (N m p : ℕ) (Q : In B.a m p)
    (u : ℝ → ℝ) (S : ℝ → Activities G (B.a.S.side m p)) : Prop where
  early x : x ∈ s → (S x).EBound (B.a.budget m) (funds B.a m q / 4)
  emit x : x∈s → ∀ V, flags (B.a.budget m).threshold V = ∅ →
    let R := B.kin.path N m; let A := (B.a.params m).clip
    target Q x V = Real.exp (u x * sites (B.a.S.side m p) - ((Q x).beta * mainTerm A R V + B.kin.alpha N m * secondTerm A R V + loop R V) -
      (S x).additive (B.a.budget m) V)

proof_context.conclusion: `Prereset` states the early `EBound` of the family by `funds/4` and, on flag-free configurations, `target = exp(u|Lambda| - (beta*main + alpha*second + loop) - additive)`.

snippet.text:
lemma Prereset.value_income (h : Prereset B q s N m p Q u S) (hV : flags (B.a.budget m).threshold V = ∅)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x∈s) :
    (0 < target Q x 1 ∧ 0 < target Q x V) ∧ |scalar (target Q) x - u x| ≤ funds B.a m q / 4 ∧
      |vacuumError B N Q V x| ≤ sites (B.a.S.side m p) * (funds B.a m q / 2) := by
  have h₀ := preBound (h.early x hx) (flags_one _)
  have hh := preBound (h.early x hx) hV
  constructor
  · exact ⟨(Real.exp_pos _).trans_eq (h.emit x hx 1 (flags_one _)).symm,(Real.exp_pos _).trans_eq (h.emit x hx V hV).symm⟩
  constructor
  · let n := B.a.S.side m p
    have hn : sites n ≠ 0 := (sites_pos n).ne'
    rw [scalar,h.flat hx,sub_div,mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hn,sub_sub_cancel_left,abs_neg, abs_div,abs_of_pos (sites_pos n)]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (sites_pos n)).mpr; rw [mul_comm]; exact h₀
  unfold vacuumError contrast; rw [h.flat hx,h.emit x hx _ hV,Real.log_exp]
  obtain ⟨h1,h2⟩ := abs_le.mp h₀; obtain ⟨h3,h4⟩ := abs_le.mp hh; exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith,by linarith⟩

proof_context.conclusion: On flag-free V, `target Q x 1 > 0` and `target Q x V > 0`, `|scalar - u| <= funds/4`, and the vacuum error is at most `sites * funds/2`.

lemma grants {E} (hW : Testing.Ringing K g W) (bill : Cosmos Z K W g r E) (hm : m<N)
    (hb : ∀ x∈l,Lives B.bake N (m+1) p (Q x) ∧ (Q x).beta∈band B.a (m+1))
    (ha : ∀ x∈l,atlas B N T d χ r (Q x) X (v x) (τ x)) (hs : ∀ x∈l, Local X (B.a.budget m) (v x) (H x) (w x))
    (he : ∀ x∈l, H x ≤ funds B.a m q / 4) :
    (∀ x∈l, target Q x = earlyValue X (B.kin.path N m) (B.a.params m).clip (B.a.budget m) (v x) (Q x).beta (τ x) (B.kin.alpha N m)) ∧
    Prereset B q l N m p Q τ (fun x => X.read (v x)) := by
  have h (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ l) := ((earnings B N T d χ r hW bill hm (Q x) (hb x hx).1 (hb x hx).2).2.2).trans (ha x hx)
  refine ⟨h,fun x hx => ?_, fun x hx V hV => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨u,hu,hk⟩ := (hs x hx).unweighted; exact ⟨u,hu,fun o => Push.AbsoluteSums.budget_loosen (hk o) (he x hx)⟩
  change _ = Real.exp _
  let R := B.kin.path N m; let c := (B.a.params m).clip
  have hu := unmasked_precision R c hV
  have hr := B.support.cap N m hm.le
  have ht : receipt R c (B.a.budget m) V = secondTerm c R V := allGoodPrice hr V hV
  change (B.a.clock.op m p).push (Q x).beta (Q x).eval V = _
  rw [h x hx,earlyValue,Rep.eval]
  change Real.exp _ * (X.read (v x)).gas (B.a.budget m) V * _ = _
  rw [Activities.gas_one _ _ hV, mul_one,← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  change (τ x * sites _ - R.inChannels c (B.a.budget m) (Q x).beta V - _) + -_ * receipt R c _ V = _
  rw [Push.BetaTransport.channels_split V (Q x).beta, hu.1,hu.2.1,ht]; dsimp only [frozen,R,c]; ring

proof_context.conclusion: `grants` obtains `Prereset` with `u = tau` and `S = X.read (v x)` from `atlas` and `Local`, using `unmasked_precision`.
